propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient transport with empty credentials (url/user/api_token resolved as empty strings) without raising an error, deferring failure to first API call instead of failing at construction time.
The absence of presence and format validation on Cloud credentials creates a test-parity gap with DC, which validates JIRA_PAT loudly at construction via assert_env_ready.

JIRA_USER must be validated as an email address (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) before AcliClient construction, since Cloud Basic-auth requires the Atlassian account email and a bare handle silently 401s.
The held-out test test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently documents and pins the silent-build behavior rather than asserting the desired fail-fast behavior.

BackendEnvError should be raised at _build_jira_backend construction when any of JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, or JIRA_API_TOKEN is missing/empty/whitespace-only or JIRA_USER lacks valid email format, naming all missing variables and the anonymous-access consequence in one message.
